title: research: realize PR992 sharp T29 profile with exact bin inventories
head: 08465c27282638153778825abfd82c43f86ff26c
body:
PR #992 gives a sharp T=29 residual profile in the historical fixed-U8 arithmetic relaxation, while explicitly leaving bin-type realization outside its scope. This contribution supplies an exact capacity-tagged integer packing for that profile, satisfying all four bin-capacity quotas and all five whole-helper width inventories.

The ten-pattern certificate accounts for all 58,464 bins and 131,544 helpers, including 49,770 zero-residual bins. A short proof explains why zero signed-price slack forces every bin to be tight and identifies the resulting structural constraints. A separate agent independently derived a different valid ten-pattern witness before seeing the implementation. Both realizations are checked; this establishes nonuniqueness without asserting a larger feasible family.

Validation:

- `python3 -I -O -B research/t29-capacity-audit/verify.py` checks source pins, one Cartesian enumeration of all 1,163 legal patterns and an independent maximum-price dynamic program, the exact witness, and 31 negative controls for malformed certificates and inventory violations.
- The independent reviewer checks weighted inventories and expands every bin and helper into literal unit slots; controls include mutations that preserve aggregate mass and price while violating a capacity or helper census.
- Independent post-fix review accepted the package after resolving all four initial findings; both the original findings and accepted review receipt are preserved.
- The exact 13-file patch cleanly applies and both checkers pass on original base `ba82555c64e1879e4b7decce28186f208fcb8262` and freshly fetched main `c0e3631dc24e3c24a861f7d3d79e0608481cccec`.
- Exact integer arithmetic, standard library only, no solver or network required for reproduction. Commands work with Python optimization enabled.

Scope: abstract capacity-tagged packing for the fixed U8 T29 inventory only. This does not construct invocation-specific matching, chronology, geometry, a physical owner schedule, or a new κ; it does not concern the changed PR #1042 supplier. It confirms that the predecessor’s sharpness example survives these inventory constraints, without alleging a defect in the predecessor.

Base: `ba82555c64e1879e4b7decce28186f208fcb8262`. All changes are confined to `research/t29-capacity-audit/`; the selected frontier and upstream sources are unchanged.

Credits: Chafik Boukhalfa (#795/#890 prices and family), Jonathan Capalbo (#942 all-replica relaxation), woklerx (#992 sharpness and slack lattice), and Hao Yan (#858 controller lineage). Substantial AI assistance: Claude Fable 5.1 implementation, GPT-6 Astra independent mathematical review, Gemini 3.8 Flash control brainstorming, and Codex coordination. Separate-agent review is not human peer review. See the package proof, source pins, and review receipts for evidence and limitations.
limits: Metadata and source identity only. Checks require source/command/coverage review; no green-badge inference.
